name: Rafael Cardoso
bio: Rafael Cezar Cardoso (born November 17, 1985) is a Brazilian actor.
place: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

credits.title: Eu Sou a Lei
credits.overview: A quiet and devoted father's life is transformed when his only daughter is murdered on her graduation day. Dealing with grief and nonconformity in a country marked by impunity, he seeks justice, resorting to a dangerous ruse that could leave him hostage to the killer.

credits.title: 8 Segundos: O Desafio
credits.overview: Helena is the daughter of rancher Sinval and the sister of João Donato, a renowned international rodeo champion. Her dream is to become a top female rodeo rider, despite her father’s objections, so she divides her time between secret riding practice and her work as a doctor in Barretos.

credits.title: Sexo e Destino
credits.overview: Between two families marked by betrayal and obsession, the Nogueiras and the Torres, forces from the spiritual realm work to lead each member to a reckoning with their own destiny.

credits.title: Nothing Happens By Chance
credits.overview: When Marina returns from a trip with five million reais in her account, she just wants to move forward without looking back and forgetting what she did to get that amount. However, a series of constant encounters between her, Maria Eugênia, Henrique and the couple's son cannot be just a coincidence.

credits.title: Detetives do Prédio Azul 3: Uma Aventura no Fim do Mundo
credits.overview: Severino finds a magic medallion and becomes bewitched. To save their friend and prevent the forces of evil from dominating him forever, Sol, Bento, Pippo and Berenice embark on an icy adventure in the snow and go to the End of the World!

credits.title: The Trace We Leave Behind
credits.overview: A young physician coordinating the transfer of patients between state-run hospitals in the city of Rio de Janeiro struggles with a mystery: a patient goes missing one night and completely disappears from the system. As the doctor attempts to find out the truth, he slowly loses his sense of reality.

credits.title: Os Senhores da Guerra
credits.overview: During the Rio Grande do Sul revolution of 1923, two brothers fight on opposite sides.

credits.title: Time and the Wind
credits.overview: Based on Érico Verissimo's literary trilogy, Time and the Wind follows 150 years of the Terra Cambará family and their opponents, the Amaral family. credits.title: From Beginning to End
credits.overview: Two brothers develop a very close relationship as they are growing up in an idyllic and happy family. When they are young adults their relationship becomes very intimate, romantic, and sexual.
